The '''Power Distributor''' is a core internal module fitted to every ship. It draws from the [[Power Plant]] and divides that power between three capacitors — '''SYS''' (shields), '''ENG''' (engines/boost), and '''WEP''' (weapons) — each of which the Commander can manage in real time during flight.

== Overview ==

Power Distributor capacity and recharge rate determine how often a Commander can boost, how quickly shields recover after dropping, and how long weapons can be fired before their capacitor runs dry. Because it affects three different subsystems at once, Power Distributor Engineering choices are usually made around a specific build's priorities rather than one universal "best" configuration.
